title: Longitudinal study of psychological and hormonal bonding indicators in mother and infant after a premature birth, compared to births at term
summary: The aim of this study is to investigate more intensively the highly sensitive time around birth for mother and child, which represents a period of high stress for mothers of premature babies.
conditions: Disorders related to short gestation and low birth weight, not elsewhere classified

interventions.name:
Experimental group (VG): 50 mothers-to-be admitted to hospital with a threatened premature birth before the 32+0/33 week of pregnancy (WP) and giving birth before the 34+0 WP. 

Quasi-experimental long-term study.
